title: Where It All Began
description: Our first date at that hidden coffee shop. We supposed to meet for 'a quick coffee', but ended up talking for five hours straight until the barista started stacking chairs.
quote: "I knew within the first ten minutes that you were going to turn my world upside down."

title: The Ocean and You
description: Our first weekend getaway. We drove up the coast with no map, windows down, singing along to outdated pop songs. The sunset over the sea was stunning, but I couldn't keep my eyes off you.

title: Culinary Disaster #1
description: We attempted to make handmade gnocchi from scratch. It turned into a sticky, flour-covered paste that glued our hands together. We ended up ordering a cheap pizza and eating it on the kitchen floor.
quote: "Flour looks good in your hair, but maybe we stick to ordering takeout."

title: Under the City Lights
description: A freezing Valentine's Day. We wrapped ourselves in a giant wool blanket on a rooftop overlooking the skyline, sipping hot chocolate and shivering, feeling warmer than ever.
quote: "No matter how cold the night, you are my home and my hearth."

title: Dancing in the Rain
description: An unexpected downpour caught us off guard in the botanical gardens. Instead of running for cover, you grabbed my hands and dragged me onto the wet lawns for an impromptu slow dance.
quote: "Some people feel the rain, others just get wet. With you, every drop is a symphony."

title: A Quiet Sunday Morning
description: Nothing grand. Just sunlight filtering through the curtains, the aroma of fresh coffee brewing, and you curled up sleeping peacefully next to me. The perfect snapshot of our quiet bliss.
quote: "In your silence, I find my absolute peace."
